results.title: Bacaro bags two golds in Asian Youth and Junior weightlifting tilt
results.description: Philippine weightlifting continues to produce potential Hidilyn Diaz-Naranjo successors, and Althea Bacaro could be one of them.

results.title: ‘Clear process’ yields 8-for as rookie pacer Thompson tears through Tigers
results.description: Despite having played only one previous first-class match, Thompson repeatedly found the right length and forced Bangladesh's batters into mistakes.
